transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

I came in because lately I just can’t keep my head clear at work. I’ll be with a client and lose track of what they’re saying, or I’ll reread the same chart note over and over and it still doesn’t sink in. Even simple decisions I used to handle, I kind of freeze on them now.
Have you noticed any changes in your memory, attention, or ability to think clearly outside of work situations?

Yeah, it’s mostly the same kind of thing outside of work too. I feel like my head isn’t clear. I’ll lose track of what someone is saying, or I’ll have to go back over something a few times before it really registers. And little decisions that used to be easy, I just sort of get stuck on them.
Have you been dealing with any stressful or upsetting events recently that might be affecting your ability to focus or think clearly?

Yeah. I think it started about a month ago, when the clinic lost some staff. My schedule got shifted into more late-evening coverage, and there’s been a lot more crisis paperwork. Since then it’s just been harder to keep my thoughts together.
Have you felt down, sad, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy during this time?

Yeah… I’ve definitely lost interest in things. My guitar’s just been sitting in the corner. I keep bailing on soccer and volunteering at the shelter. Even when I try to cook or go hiking, it just feels like I’m going through the motions, like there’s no real point to it.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these feelings of sadness and loss of interest been happening every day, and have they lasted throughout the day?

It’s been about a month, I think. It started around when the clinic lost staff and my schedule got pushed into more late-evening coverage, with a lot more crisis paperwork. Since then, yeah, it’s been pretty constant.
Have you been feeling down on yourself or felt like you’re not worth much during this time?

Yeah… I have. I keep getting really hard on myself. Like if I miss one detail in a note or don’t return a call right away, I start telling myself I’m useless, and that I’m letting the clients and everyone at the clinic down.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy level or felt unusually tired lately, even when you haven’t been doing much?
Yeah. I feel tired all the time lately. Even small things like showering, driving to the clinic, or just trying to finish paperwork feel like I’m dragging around a backpack full of bricks.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up frequently during the night, or waking up earlier than usual and not being able to go back to sleep?

Yeah, my sleep’s been pretty bad. I’ll get home exhausted, but then I just lie there for hours replaying everything from the day. And when I do finally fall asleep, I wake up before my alarm and feel like I barely slept at all.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating a lot less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

Yeah, I’ve been eating less. Most days I don’t really feel hungry unless someone reminds me to eat, and I’ll realize I skipped a meal without meaning to. My pants have been fitting looser too, so I think I’ve lost some weight.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living or had thoughts about hurting yourself?
Yeah… I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself. But I do keep having thoughts like… it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And that scares me, because I know what that can mean.
